title: Low filesystem capacity

definition.name: [Lustre] Low filesystem capacity
definition.message:
Lustre filesystem capacity is running low (<10% available space).

This could lead to:
* Failed write operations
* Application errors
* Job failures
* Performance degradation

{{#is_alert}}
Available space: {{value}}%
Device: {{device_uuid.name}}
{{/is_alert}}

Immediate actions:
1. Check which files/directories are consuming space
2. Archive or delete unnecessary data
3. Add more storage capacity if needed
4. Review data retention policies
